01 / Who we are
who
WE ARE?

Ciccone Records is an independent record label focused on artists and creative projects from the AI and Meta communities.

We provide a professional structure for developing artists, releasing music, and building distinctive creative identities.

From music production and artist development to distribution, visual direction and promotion, we support each project throughout its journey.
